item.name: Auto-detect
item.description: One endpoint for every supported platform: send any supported link and the platform is detected for you.

item.name: Download media from any supported link (platform auto-detected)

request.name: Download media from any supported link (platform auto-detected)

description.content:
Send one link from **Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube (including Shorts and Music), Likee, X (Twitter), Facebook or RuTube**. The platform is detected from the URL and the answer has the same shape as the matching endpoint plus the `source` field.

**Price: 5 credits** per successful request. A `4xx` answer costs at most 1 credit, a `5xx` answer is free. `/api/v1/auto` costs as much as the platform it resolves to: 5 credits for most platforms, 6 for Instagram and TikTok, 15 for YouTube.
(Required) Link to a post or video on any supported platform (Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Likee, X, Facebook, RuTube). Share text that contains a link is accepted too.

item.name: Instagram
item.description: Reels, posts, photos and carousels from public Instagram accounts.

item.name: Download Instagram Reels, videos, photos and carousels

request.name: Download Instagram Reels, videos, photos and carousels

description.content:
Extracts media from **public** Instagram posts, Reels and multi-slide carousels. The `media` array holds one item per file (and per available size for photos) with `type` (`video` or `photo`), a direct file URL and a quality label. `video_url` / `video_hd_url` point at the main video and `thumbnail` at the preview image.

Private accounts and stories are not available.

**Price: 6 credits** per successful request. A `4xx` answer costs at most 1 credit, a `5xx` answer is free.
(Required) Public HTTPS link to an Instagram post or Reel (`instagram.com/p/...` or `/reel/...`).
Content type hint for the parser. The default `media` works for photos and videos.

item.name: YouTube

item.name: Download YouTube video and audio (MP4, WebM, M4A, Opus)

request.name: Download YouTube video and audio (MP4, WebM, M4A, Opus)

description.content:
Accepts `youtube.com`, `youtu.be`, Shorts and `music.youtube.com` links. Returns `title`, `author`, `duration_sec`, the thumbnail and the full list of available formats in `media`: MP4 / WebM video in several resolutions and M4A / Opus audio-only streams. Use [`GET /api/v1/youtube/file`](#operation/downloadYouTubeFile) to receive the file itself instead of a CDN link.

**Price: 15 credits** per successful request. A `4xx` answer costs at most 1 credit, a `5xx` answer is free.

item.name: X (Twitter)
item.description: Videos, GIFs and photos from X (Twitter) posts.

item.name: Download X (Twitter) videos, GIFs and photos

request.name: Download X (Twitter) videos, GIFs and photos

description.content:
Accepts post links in the `x.com/<account>/status/<id>` and `twitter.com/<account>/status/<id>` form, including posts with several attachments. For videos every MP4 variant is returned from best to worst with a quality label and frame height; GIFs come back as short MP4 videos with quality `GIF`; photos in their original size. `video_hd_url` is the best quality, `video_url` a variant up to 720p, `title` holds the post text and `author` the account handle.

The same endpoint also answers at `/api/v1/twitter`.

**Price: 5 credits** per successful request. A `4xx` answer costs at most 1 credit, a `5xx` answer is free.

item.name: Download the media file of an Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, Likee, X, Facebook or RuTube post

request.name: Download the media file of an Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, Likee, X, Facebook or RuTube post

description.content:
Streams the best video (or photo) of a post as a regular file with `Content-Length`, so clients that cannot open the CDN link directly (Telegram bots, browsers with hotlink protection) can use a plain URL. For RuTube the HLS stream is remuxed to MP4 on the fly (without `Content-Length`).

Provide either `source` + `url` or the short token `p`.

**Free:** file downloads cost no credits (the metadata request that produced the link was already charged). A valid API key is still required - pass it as the `api` query parameter when the client cannot send headers, e.g. Telegram fetching a file by URL.
Platform of the link. Use together with `url`. (This can only be one of instagram,tiktok,pinterest,likee,x,facebook,rutube)
Original post URL. Use together with `source`.
Short token that encodes `source` and `url`. Alternative to passing `source` + `url`.

info.name: InterAPI
info.description:
InterAPI - social media downloader API: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X (Twitter), Facebook, Pinterest, RuTube, Likee, YouTube search and Shazam. Generated from the OpenAPI 3.1 spec: https://github.com/Shukurov777/interapi-openapi

Set the `apiKey` collection variable to your key (get one with 1,000 free credits at https://interapi.dev). The key is sent in the X-API-Key header.
